[executive summary]
- No existing open-source project is MYTHOS Communication OS; each covers one layer (transport, helpdesk, LLM platform, automation, flows, sales CRM).
- MYTHOS already has the right shape (COMMS-1…8: provider-neutral Core, exactly-once receiver, inbox/contacts UI, human outbound, suggest-only AI, multi-service model) — all OFF in production.
- **Decision:** hybrid — `CommunicationProvider` contract with Evolution API first and Meta Cloud API second, native MYTHOS Communication Core + MYTHOS AI as the system of record, native automation rules with n8n optional, Chatwoot / Evo CRM / Dify / Twenty / Typebot as references only. Score 8.6/10 (Chatwoot-as-core 5.8, Evo CRM-as-core 4.8, Evolution+Dify+n8n 4.5).

[research scope and sources]
Repository reconnaissance (mythos-wp Core, migrations 0001–0004, receiver, inbox, outbound, assistant, multiservice); 27 primary repositories/doc sites (GitHub API metadata, README, source, LICENSE, official docs: Meta developers, docs.typebot.com, developers.chatwoot.com, docs.n8n.io, docs.dify.ai, waha.devlike.pro, core.telegram.org); 24 GitHub issue threads for failures; 6 web sweeps (vendor blogs treated as INFERENCE-grade only). Full URL list in the artifact §4.

[projects evaluated]
Evolution API, Chatwoot, Evo CRM Community (+ ai-processor, flow, bot-runtime), Dify, n8n, Typebot, Twenty, EspoCRM, SuiteCRM, ERPNext / Frappe CRM, WAHA, WPPConnect, Venom, whatsapp-web.js, Baileys, whatsmeow, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, Messenger/Instagram Platform, Telegram Bot API.

[comparison (average score, 16 criteria)]
Build everything 7.1 · Chatwoot core 5.8 · Evo CRM core 4.8 · Evolution+Chatwoot 5.4 · Evolution+Dify+n8n 4.5 · Evolution+native Core 8.1 · **Hybrid 8.6**.

[risks (must not repeat)]
Phone-keyed contact identity (Meta BSUID/usernames 2026, Chatwoot #13837); passkey-linking and stale-QR pairing failures; silent inbound webhook loss after days (Evolution #2647, WAHA #1456); outbound stuck PENDING with 200 OK (Evolution #2597); Error 463 reachout-timelock bans on cold outbound (Baileys #2707); unsigned, non-retried Evolution webhooks vs signed, retried, duplicating Meta webhooks; media keys/base64 in payloads; transport DB/logs as system of record (Signal-key leak incident); host memory pressure; Evolution 2.4.0 manual licence activation (#2534); Cloud API per-message pricing changes.

[licensing (official license files)]
Evolution / Evo CRM: Apache-2.0 + logo + usage-notification clause · Chatwoot: MIT core, Enterprise licence for `enterprise/` (Captain AI) · Dify: Apache modified, no multi-tenant without permission · n8n: Sustainable Use (internal use only) · Typebot: FSL-1.1 (no competing use) · Twenty: AGPL-3.0 (+MIT SDK) · EspoCRM / SuiteCRM / Frappe CRM: AGPL-3.0 · ERPNext: GPL-3.0 · WAHA / WPPConnect / Venom / whatsapp-web.js: Apache-2.0 · Baileys: MIT · whatsmeow: MPL-2.0.

[architecture]
Channel → Provider (contract) → Account (reserved list, rotation) → Instance → Inbox (project × account × channel, switches) → Communication Core (tenant = project) → Conversation / Message / Attachment / Events → Intelligence (intent → context → memory → knowledge → products/stock → rules → AI → policy gate) → Suggest | Auto-reply | Handoff → business systems, audit, analytics, automations. Number lifecycle, Evolution → Cloud API migration, Instagram/Messenger/Telegram/web chat/email providers, media pipeline, event model, security: artifact §10.

[reuse matrix (summary)]
Reuse as is: Evolution (transport), Meta Cloud API (second provider), n8n (optional, internal). Patterns only: Chatwoot (lifecycle, contact_inboxes, automation rules, events, reports), Evo CRM (pipelines, scheduled actions), Dify (RAG hygiene, run tracing), Twenty (custom objects), EspoCRM/Frappe (ACL), Typebot (flow model). Native: provider contract, Core, identities, CRM-light, knowledge, AI, suggest/auto/handoff, media, events, analytics, permissions, audit.

[roadmap]
A Foundation (done) · B Messaging (COMMS-9 next) · C Inbox · D CRM · E AI · F Auto-reply · G Handoff · H Media · I Automation · J Analytics · K Multi-channel · L Cloud API — each with dependencies, DB/API/UI/tests/security/production gate in the artifact §12.

[open questions (owner)]
Service order after SSANGYONG.AUTOS; LLM provider and budget; WABA/Cloud API number now or later; retention windows; keep n8n as automation consumer.

[recommended next implementation task]
**MYTHOS-COMMS-9 — Provider contract + event ledger hardening** (`CommunicationProvider` interface, provider-neutral event names, `wp_contact_identities` incl. BSUID, delivery reconciliation alarm, dead-letter replay, contract tests). Not implemented by this research.
